import parse

print('=== R1: letters format specifier ===')
# Test basic letters matching

print('Letters match: ' + str(r.named))
r_fail = p.parse('hello123')
print('Letters reject digits: ' + str(r_fail))

# Test width constraint
p2 = parse.Parser('{n:3l}')
r2 = p2.parse('abc')
print('Width 3l match: ' + str(r2.named))
r2_fail = p2.parse('abcd')
print('Width 3l reject long: ' + str(r2_fail))

# Test repeated name error
try:
    p3 = parse.Parser('{x:d} {x:l}')
    print('ERROR: Should have raised RepeatedNameError')
except parse.RepeatedNameError as e:
    print('RepeatedNameError raised: OK')

print()
print('=== R2: Result.__contains__ ===')
p = parse.Parser('{name:s} {age:d}')
r = p.parse('Alice 30')
print('Key \"name\" in result: ' + str('name' in r))
print('Key \"z\" in result: ' + str('z' in r))
print('Value \"Alice\" in result: ' + str('Alice' in r))
print('Value 30 in result: ' + str(30 in r))
print('Value 99 in result: ' + str(99 in r))
print('Index 0 in result: ' + str(0 in r))
print('Fixed tuple access: ' + str(r.fixed))

# Test Match.__contains__
p = parse.Parser('{name:s}')

print('Match contains key \"name\": ' + str('name' in m))
print('Match contains value \"Alice\": ' + str('Alice' in m))

print()
print('=== R3: Brace validation ===')
# Unmatched opening brace

    p = parse.Parser('{name')
    print('ERROR: Should have raised ValueError for unclosed brace')
except ValueError as e:
    print('Unclosed brace error: ' + str(e))

# Unmatched closing brace
try:
    p = parse.Parser('test}')
    print('ERROR: Should have raised ValueError for stray }')
except ValueError as e:
    print('Stray } error: ' + str(e))

# Escaped braces work
p = parse.Parser('{{literal}}')
r = p.parse('{literal}')
print('Escaped braces work: ' + str(r))

# Complex pattern with nested-looking braces
p = parse.Parser('{a:d} text {b:s}')
r = p.parse('123 text hello')
print('Complex pattern works: ' + str(r.named))

print()
print('All requirements verified!')
